description: This __init__.py file in the xtts package sets up a deprecated module proxy for the 'xtts' module, relaying attribute access to the underlying 'xtts.tts' module and emitting deprecation warnings.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to emit deprecation warnings when the 'xtts' module is accessed and to delegate attribute access to the underlying 'xtts.tts' module.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DeprecatedModuleProxy that initializes the proxy with the target module and issues deprecation warnings.
